name: TOTP Management Success
summary: An authenticated user manages the TOTP capability associated with the current durable identity, including rotating recovery codes or disabling/resetting the enrolled MFA configuration without changing identity.
finalOutcome: The requested TOTP maintenance operation has been applied to the current durable identity while the durable identity itself remains unchanged.

sourceReferences.note: The manager contract supports recovery-code rotation, TOTP/MFA disable, and MFA reset operations.

Behavior-universe reconciliation groups TOTP maintenance actions under a single user-facing management capability until scenario decomposition determines whether separate outcome behaviors are warranted.
